description:
CyrusGuard AI — Your Smart Shield Against Digital Fraud

Got a suspicious text? A shady link? A weird message? CyrusGuard AI analyzes it all in seconds using artificial intelligence and instantly tells you if it's a scam.

SMART SCAM DETECTION
Paste a suspicious SMS, message, or text and get a clear risk score as a percentage. The higher the percentage (80-100%), the more likely it's a scam. Below 30%, the content is generally safe. The AI identifies phishing attempts, fake job offers, fraudulent banking sites, and all forms of digital fraud.

IMAGE & SCREENSHOT SCANNING
Take a photo or upload a screenshot of a suspicious text, WhatsApp message, Facebook post, or any other content. The AI reads and analyzes it for you in seconds.

WEBSITE ANALYSIS
Enter a URL and find out if the site can be trusted, with a risk score as a percentage. CyrusGuard checks the SSL certificate, legal disclosures, privacy policy, suspicious redirects, and the company information behind the site.

FRAUD ALERTS
Stay informed about the latest scams circulating worldwide — fake bank alerts, delivery scams, utility company fraud, and more. Always stay one step ahead of scammers.

EASY REPORTING
CyrusGuard connects you directly to official reporting organizations in your region, with their contact details and direct links.

WHAT YOU GET
— Instant analysis of SMS, WhatsApp and Facebook messages
— Complete website trustworthiness verification
— Smart image and screenshot scanning
— Risk score as a percentage with detailed explanation
— Regularly updated fraud alerts
— Access to official reporting organizations
— Clean, easy-to-use interface in English and French

SUBSCRIPTION AND FREE TRIAL
CyrusGuard AI is an auto-renewing subscription service. A 7-day free trial is available for eligible new subscribers, with no charge during the trial.

— CyrusGuard AI Pro Monthly: 1-month subscription, renewed every month.
— CyrusGuard AI Pro Annual: 12-month subscription, renewed every year.

The exact price in your local currency is shown on the subscription screen inside the app before any purchase. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase, or at the end of the 7-day free trial if you have not cancelled. The subscription renews automatically unless it is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription at any time in your Apple Account settings. Any unused portion of a free trial is forfeited when a subscription is purchased.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://iacyrusguard.com/Privacy

Your digital security is our priority.
promotionalText: Detect scams in seconds. Analyze suspicious texts, URLs and images with AI. Protect yourself against digital fraud.
